references.text: The Aaronic blessing that God commanded Aaron and his sons to use when they blessed the people of Israel, as Aaron performs here in Leviticus 9:22.
The priests, the sons of Levi, are chosen to bless in the Lord's name, just as Aaron does after the sacrificial service.
Solomon stood and blessed the entire assembly of Israel after the temple dedication, in a similar way that Aaron blessed the people after completing the sacrificial service.
The Levitical priests stood up and blessed the people, and their voice was heard, parallel to Aaron's blessing of the people.
Jesus lifted his hands and blessed the disciples before he was taken up into heaven, just as Aaron lifted his hands to bless the people.
Melchizedek blessed Abraham, and to bless is a priestly function, just as Aaron performed here as high priest.
